title: Concept registry (canonical)
description: Hand-authored concept registry (taxonomy/concepts.json). One row per (noun, unit_canonical, normalisation) triple — the citizen-readable fact a concept_id stands for. Every indicator in datasets/taxonomy/indicators.json MUST FK to a concept_id (enforced post-PR-Z3b via Tier-B tier_b_one_indicator_per_concept). Two indicators sharing the same (concept_id, entity_kind) tuple is the proliferation signal that PR-Z3b rejects. Ships in PR-Z3a (this file + concepts.json seed + find_overlap() helper); the indicator-catalogue concept_id FK + CLI + Tier-B + CI gate ship in PR-Z3b (docs/archive/plans/20260526-grain-over-entity-and-storage-decoupling-plan.md §2 PR-Z3, guardrails #13-#18).

x-changelog.description: Initial concept registry schema (PR-Z3a). Seeded from the 183 indicator rows in datasets/taxonomy/indicators.json by clustering on (label_short, unit, normalisation) → 164 concepts. Hand-authored taxonomy per ADR-0002; sources[] left empty (concepts are nouns, not series). Additive: schema introduction does NOT modify any existing artifact. PR-Z3b will add the FK on indicator-catalogue.schema.json + the find_overlap() CLI + the four Tier-B checks (tier_b_one_indicator_per_concept, tier_b_indicator_has_justification, tier_b_facet_promotion_warning, tier_b_indicator_freshness_declared) + the GitHub Action indicator-add-gate.

PR-A2 Parliament PC ingest (TODO/20260531-uk-style-elections-experience-plan.md). ADDITIVE MINOR: widen the entity_kinds[].items enum from {country,state,district,ac,party,candidate} to add 'pc' (parliamentary constituency / Parliament grain). Nothing removed/narrowed. Unlocks the 13 per-grain PC sibling concepts (Model C, Gregor 2026-06-01) -- each entity_kinds:[pc] -- mirroring the deliberate per-grain split precedent (winning-party-ac / winning-party-state). v1.0 rows validate unchanged under v1.1; consumer datasets/taxonomy/concepts.json stamp bumped 1.0 -> 1.1.

concept_id.description: PK. Kebab-case, single segment, max 40 chars. The slug a citizen-facing question maps to ('electricity-used-per-person', 'cattle-population', 'state-gva').

noun.description: Short human noun for the concept (matches indicator label_short style). Example: 'Per-capita electricity'.

unit_canonical.description: The canonical unit indicators FK'd to this concept emit in. Indicators in a different unit are a different concept.

normalisation.description: How the concept is normalised. Indicators with different normalisations are different concepts (counts vs shares are not interchangeable).

entity_kinds.description: Grain axes the concept makes sense at. Union across all FK'd indicators. A concept may live at multiple grains (country + state) iff the same noun + unit + normalisation applies.

description_short.description: One-sentence citizen-readable definition. What a non-technical reader would say the concept IS.

sources.description: Hand-authored taxonomy per ADR-0002 — concepts are nouns, not series. Empty by convention; per-indicator provenance lives on the observation row's source_id (CLAUDE.md §12).
